clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken scouts watch Alliance movements from Southpoint Tower, near Hillsbrad's western edge. The ruined Lordaeron post overlooks the road into Silverpine Forest.

Southpoint Tower overlooks the highway between Silverpine Forest and Hillsbrad Foothills. The Kingdom of Lordaeron built it to guard traffic between the eastern farmlands and the western woods. After the Third War and the Scourge's destruction of the kingdom, the stonework fell into ruin. Now the tower stands roofless and crumbling, a remnant of human rule in fractured lands.

Forsaken agents watch Alliance patrols from the ruined tower. Deathstalker Lesh is among those stationed there, keeping an eye on nearby human settlements in Hillsbrad Fields and travelers on the main road. The vantage remains valuable despite the collapsed walls. So close to hostile territory, this lonely post often becomes a flashpoint for skirmishes.
